camdrones.mod.name: Propwash: Camera Drones
camdrones.mod.description: Programmable camera drones for Propwash FPV
camdrones.switch.mode_normal.description: Speed-controlled flight; let go of the sticks to brake and hold position. Propwash's flight mode Angle selects N as well.
camdrones.switch.mode_cine.description: Slow flight with smoothed sticks for calm shots. Propwash's flight mode Horizon selects C as well.
camdrones.switch.mode_sport.description: Manual flight with a 35° angle limit, without obstacle braking. Propwash's flight mode Acro selects S as well.
camdrones.switch.mode_cycle.description: Switches N → C → S like Propwash's flight mode key (default R); the last change on the radio or key counts.
camdrones.switch.pause.description: Pauses the mission or smart function and hovers in place.
camdrones.switch.mission_start.descripti: Starts the drone's active mission or resumes it.
camdrones.switch.waypoint_add.descriptio: Stores position, height and heading as a waypoint.
camdrones.switch.follow_me.description: Follows the owner while the switch is on.
camdrones.switch.poi_here.description: Sets a point of interest at the image center and circles it.
camdrones.nav.poi_refused: Point of interest: no target at the image center within %s m
camdrones.switch.course_lock.description: Forward always flies the stored direction; yaw only turns nose and camera.
camdrones.switch.gimbal_lock.description: The gimbal follows the frame or keeps its direction.
camdrones.switch.gimbal_recenter.descrip: Centers the gimbal; pressed twice, it points straight down.
camdrones.switch.gimbal_fpv.description: The image rolls with the frame like an FPV camera; the tilt stays stabilized. Overrides follow/lock.
camdrones.switch.pilot_view.description: Switches your picture between the fixed FPV camera on the frame and the gimbal camera. Only without a camera operator; every flight starts with the FPV camera.
gamerule.camdrones.allow_autonomy.descri: Camera drones fly without a pilot: hold, missions, point of interest and follow me, also after leaving the FPV view. Off: the drone lands or returns home as without the add-on.
Follow me on other players, always with their consent. Off: only the owner, own pets and mounts.
gamerule.camdrones.allow_operator.descri: A second player may operate the gimbal camera of a camera drone.
gamerule.camdrones.max_altitude.descript: Highest altitude of camera drones in metres above the take-off point, 0 = off.
gamerule.camdrones.max_distance.descript: Largest distance of camera drones from the take-off point in blocks, 0 = only Propwash's radio range.
Longest time a camera drone may fly without a pilot, 1 to 60 minutes. Then it returns home or lands; it ends earlier when the battery runs low.
